translationRepairs: In the third year of Jin Taixing, the Pingjian Yi king Xiang Hong and Xiang Qiong and others came to court seeking formal appointments; Zhang Liang of the Secretariat argued, 'Barbarian peoples must not be granted military titles.'

In the third year of Jin Taixing, the Jianping Yi king Xiang Hong and Xiang Qiong and others came to court seeking formal appointments; Zhang Liang of the Secretariat argued, 'Barbarian peoples must not be granted military titles.'
建平 is Jianping, not the reversed Pingjian.

In year 6 Tian Silu, who had served as Supervisor-Protector and Administrator of North Sui'an Left Commandery, was confirmed as acting Administrator of that district; former General Ning Shuo Tian Lüwang was made acting Administrator of Yiren Left Commandery and Tian Hedai acting Administrator of Xinping Left Commandery—all of them Man chieftains from Ying Province.

In year 6 Tian Silu, who had served as Supervisor-Protector and Administrator of North Sui'an Left Commandery, was confirmed as acting Administrator of that district; former General Who Pacifies the North Tian Lüwang was made acting Administrator of Yiren Left Commandery and Tian Hedai acting Administrator of Xinping Left Commandery—all of them Man chieftains from Ying Province.
寧朔將軍 is the title General Who Pacifies the North; 田驢王 is the office-holder's full name.

In year 9 Anlong Internal Historian Wang Xuxu drafted militia and sent Kuancheng Garrison Commander Wan Minhe to help an eight-hundred-household Man village fight a twelve-hundred-household Man village. The Man routed them; Minhe was wounded and lost horses and arms, and officials memorialized for his removal.

In year 9 Anlong Internal Historian Wang Sengxu drafted militia and sent Kuancheng Garrison Commander Wan Minhe to help an eight-hundred-household Man village fight a twelve-hundred-household Man village. The Man routed them; Minhe was wounded and lost horses and arms, and officials memorialized for his removal.
王僧旭 is Wang Sengxu; the existing rendering drops 僧.

Early in the Yongming era, Xiang Zongtou and the Qianyang Man Tian Douqu led five thousand raiders. Badong Administrator Wang Tunan sent Headquarters Major Liu Shoushou and others to hew paths through the mountains and assault their stockade; Zongtou burned the camp by night and fled.

Early in the Yongming era, Xiang Zongtou and the Qianyang Man Tian Douqu led five thousand raiders. Badong Administrator Wang Tunan sent Headquarters Major Liu Sengshou and others to hew paths through the mountains and assault their stockade; Zongtou burned the camp by night and fled.
劉僧壽 is Liu Sengshou; the existing rendering drops 僧.
